description: This file defines the LanguageInterface interface for Drupal, including constants for language codes, states, types, directions, and method signatures for language properties.

classes.name: LanguageInterface
classes.description: Interface for language-related properties and methods in Drupal.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of the language.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the text direction of the language (ltr or rtl).

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight used for ordering languages.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if this language is the default language.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks if this language is locked.
